remarks:
Enjoy maintenance-free waterfront living at the sought-after Cottages of Troutburg, beautifully situated along the shores of Lake Ontario. This charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the perfect blend of year-round comfort or an idyllic summer retreat.

Experience a lifestyle centered around ease and enjoyment, with community amenities including an inground pool, clubhouse, tennis courts, fishing pier, lawn care, snow removal, and more—allowing you to simply relax and take in the natural beauty. Watch wildlife along the water’s edge while enjoying breathtaking sunrises and stunning evening sunsets.

Inside, the home features a warm, cabin-inspired feel with a thoughtful layout, including a convenient first-floor bedroom, two full baths, and second-floor laundry. The spacious primary suite offers a private balcony—perfect for morning coffee—and a generous walk-in closet.

The well-appointed kitchen with center island flows seamlessly into the open-concept living and dining areas, making entertaining effortless. Step outside to the inviting open porch and paver patio—ideal for gatherings or quiet moments of reflection.

Additional highlights include a crawl space and generous eave storage on the second floor, providing practical space for organization. Some interior and exterior furnishings will remain, offering added convenience for a turnkey opportunity.

Recent 2024 improvements include new 6" gutters, exterior re-staining, and resealing of the second-floor bathroom ceiling—adding both value and peace of mind.

** Seller will cover HOA costs through the end of the year**
